intervals.label: hosting the HOLMES experiment
intervals.note: No source consulted gives a founding date for the laboratory. The start is borrowed from the 2013 ERC funding of the experiment (the grant started in February 2014); this is a lower bound for hosting, not a founding date. Open because Milano-Bicocca affiliations appear on the 2025 result paper.
intervals.quote: HOLMES was funded in 2013 by the European Research Council with an Advanced Grant awarded to Prof. S. Ragazzi.

name: University of Milano-Bicocca (HOLMES cryogenic laboratory)
notes: Facility record at the level needed for HOLMES; detectors are also made and tested at NIST (Boulder) and the 163Ho is produced at ILL Grenoble, none of which is recorded as a site here.

operator_text.note: The paper names 'University of Milano-Bicocca laboratory'; the ERC grant's host institution is INFN (section 3).
operator_text.quote: A cryogenic test-bed instrumented for TES arrays microwave readout is being set up at University of Milano-Bicocca laboratory.

summary.plain: The University of Milano-Bicocca in Milan, home of the HOLMES neutrino-mass experiment, which measures the electron neutrino mass from the decay of holmium-163 with ultra-cold detectors.
summary.technical: University of Milano-Bicocca (with INFN Sezione di Milano-Bicocca) laboratory hosting the HOLMES 163Ho TES-microcalorimeter programme; the ERC grant's host institution is INFN.
